title: Annotatio V §.XII (2): Pufendorf — Oral not among fundamentals; controversy is mode (§.63)
pass_a_gloss: (2.) Of PUFENDORF, that this illustrious Author inserted into his System of Fundamental articles even the Article of Oral Eating: As if Pufendorf had embraced a System of mere Fundamentals with no Prefundamentals mixed in; or had not felt more mildly about Reformed errors he saw in the Holy Supper than our Disputant would wish. Let him be read at §. 2. and especially §. 63. on the Supper, and it will easily appear he by no means numbered Oral Eating of Christ’s body as such among the foundations of Christian faith: For thus he ends his saying: But if both parts of Protestancy in good faith profess that in the Holy Supper Christ’s Body and Blood are truly and properly eaten and drunk, and that the benefits from him are participated, THE CONTROVERSY REMAINS ABOUT THE MODE OF EATING AND DRINKING, AND OF THE PRESENCE ITSELF OF CHRIST’S BODY AND BLOOD — which they acknowledge transcends human reason’s grasp, and so the matter is handled by reasonings where reason has no place. p. 229.
pass_b_english: (2) Pufendorf: inserting Oral into a fundamentals system does not prove he packed only fundamentals, or that he judged Reformed Supper “errors” as harshly as our Disputant wants.

Read §.2 and especially §.63: he does not number Oral eating as such among faith’s foundations. If both sides confess true eating and drinking of body and blood, the fight left is about the MODE of eating/drinking and of presence (p.229).
source_text: (2.) PUFENDORFII, quòd hic Illustris Autor, Systemati suo articulorum Fundamentalium, etiam Articulum de Orali Manducatione, inseruerit: Quasi verò Pufendorfius merorum Fundamentalium Systema complexus sit, nullis admixtis Præterfundamentalibus; vel non mitius, de Reformatorum sibi visis in S. Cœna erroribus, senserit, quàm Disputator noster vellet. Legatur ipse §. 2. & sigillatim §. 63. de Cœna, & facilè apparebit, Manducationem corporis Christi Oralem, quà talem, inter fidei Christianæ fundamenta haudquaquam numerasse eum: Ita enim finit dictum suum: Ceterum si utraque pars Protestantiæ bonâ fide profiteatur, in S. Cœna Corpus & Sanguinem Christi re verá ac propriè edi ac bibi, deque partis ab ipso beneficiis participari, CONTROVERSIA REMANET CIRCA MODUM COMESTIONIS ET BIBITIONIS, IPSIUSQUE PRÆSENTIÆ CORPORIS ET SANGUINIS CHRISTI; quem utique captum humanæ rationis transcendere agnoscunt, eoque ratiociniis res geritur, ubi rationi locus non est. pag. 229.

lemmas.gloss: THE CONTROVERSY REMAINS ABOUT THE MODE
